MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING

Between Meadowbrook Foods and Northgate Retail concerning a proposed distribution pilot.

The parties will negotiate pricing and delivery schedules in good faith during the sixty-day pilot period. Either party may end the pilot with written notice.
